pages.title: Sivatherium
pages.text: Sivatherium ($(o)Sivatherium maurusium$()) is an extinct giraffid that lived across Africa during the Pliocene and Pleistocene.$(br2)Unlike the modern giraffe, it was massively built, with a short neck and a heavy, okapi-like body, making it one of the largest ruminants ever known.$(br2)Males bore two pairs of ossicones: a broad, branching pair at the back of the skull and a smaller pair above the eyes.
